headline: BNP leader dies of snakebite, family alleges antivenom withheld
summary: Family members claim the political leader failed to receive necessary antivenom treatment at a local health complex.
details: A BNP leader has passed away following a snakebite, sparking allegations of medical negligence.
The family of the deceased leader has alleged that the necessary antivenom was withheld from him during his treatment.
The incident has raised concerns regarding the availability and administration of life-saving medicines in local health facilities.
Further investigations are expected to determine the cause of death and the validity of the family's claims.
caption:
A BNP leader has died from a snakebite, but his family claims he was denied life-saving antivenom.

A BNP leader has passed away following a snakebite, sparking allegations of medical negligence.

The family of the deceased leader has alleged that the necessary antivenom was withheld from him during his treatment.

The incident has raised concerns regarding the availability and administration of life-saving medicines in local health facilities.

Further investigations are expected to determine the cause of death and the validity of the family's claims.
